summary: Two-stage virtual dispatch: calls the vtable slot at +0x18 on this; if the result is non-null, re-invokes the same slot on this to obtain a fresh object, then calls the vtable slot at +28 on that object and returns its value, otherwise returns the null result (chain short-circuits). Structural twin of sub_404D20 (00404d20); subsystem 'ai'.

local_names.v3: second dispatch object (fresh result of re-invoking slot +24)

operations.description: result = (this->vtable[0x18])(this) — first virtual call, slot at byte +0x18 on this.
if (result) proceed to the second dispatch.
v3 = (this->vtable[0x18])(this) — the same slot is invoked a second time on this to obtain a new object.
return (v3->vtable[+28])(v3) — virtual call on the second object, slot at byte offset +28.
return result — null when the first dispatch returned null.

unresolved: Second dispatch reads vtable slot at byte offset +28; only the first slot (+0x18) has a dedicated field evidence entry in the packet.
